new.name: OCR cuts words off at dot leaders in a table of contents

new.output_says: 18.3 Suspension of Perfo 75 / 18.6 NSP Termination Ever 76 / 20.15 Waiver and A 84
new.why_it_matters: headings and section names in the contents are truncated mid-word, so search and quotes of section titles fail; the scanner's own text layer has the full titles but was discarded
new.lesson: keep or reconcile with the scanner text layer; do not let dot leaders end an OCR line; check TOC entries against the headings they point to
